# `task_route`

**Route a task to a profile.** Assign the agent profile that will run the task, and clear its routing gate.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `task_route` |
| Side effect | `composite` |
| Idempotency | natural |
| Retry safe | yes |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
